The bar · every surface clears all four

Northstar

The Moves module set the standard. These four properties are non-negotiable on every Source surface. The squint test — blur the screen 50%, the primary action is still obvious — is the acceptance gate.

01
One obvious next action
If the user has to hunt for what to do, the screen failed. Each surface leads with a single highest-leverage move.
02
The answer leads, machinery hides
Page 1 states the decision or the next move. Reasoning, evidence, history live below the fold or one click away.
03
Quiet hierarchy
Serif headline carries the page. Mono eyebrows used once per region, never stacked. Status color is semantic, never decorative.
04
Subtract before adding
Every element must change what the user does next. Five export buttons on a not-started doc is the anti-pattern.
Locked 2026-04-16 · do not change

Atlas §7 · Specs 9 · 10 · 14 · 17

Composed stages — same pattern, different content

These stages inherit the Strategy template (Next-Move card + demoted shelf + proportional Sentinel rail). They don't need bespoke wireframes — they compose from the established pattern. Each note carries its design verdict.

Spec 9 · Scope + RFP
Scope + RFP
Inventory table + dependency list + eval rubric. CMDB pull is explicit (provenance); rubric weights warn-not-block; dependency map = list for v1.
Spec 10 · Responses + Eval
Responses + Evaluation
Completeness matrix (R/A/G) + weighted scorecard + dissent panel (first-class, attachments allowed) + BATNA (human-named, not auto-derived).
Spec 14 · Value
Value Ledger
4-step chain: Baseline → Projected → Realized → Variance. CFO attestation reuses the approval pattern; variance card at >8% (configurable); "Locked" badge + signature trail.
Spec 17 · Audit
Audit log
Humanized action names in UI / raw enum in export; local time + UTC tooltip; AI rows tagged "Sentinel", not a different background block.
